messages:
maria: Heads-up — ACME customer story: recording slot booked for Wed 10am PT. Need final quote text, legal release, and permission to use the ARR uplift stat by EOD Tue. Draft questions here: https://docs.internal/redwood/acme-questions :point_right:
anya: I can run the interview and pull quotes. Would prefer a short CEO quote (2-3 sentences) + one technical callout from their infra lead. I'll draft and post in the doc by Monday.
josh: I can pull the metric screenshots + verification notes for the ARR uplift. Sam, confirm we can show that specific number? we may need to anonymize.
sam: Can confirm subject to ACME sign-off. I'll ask the account lead now. If they want anonymized number, we can show % uplift instead of dollar ARR. :thumbsup:
devon: I can review the release and the quote language. Please drop the signed release template into the doc or point me to the customer's legal contact. Note: if they request changes we may need 48h for review.
maria: Devon — release template added: https://docs.internal/redwood/acme-release-template
maria: Also want to tie this into the webinar on Apr 14. If we get the quote + permissions by Tue EOD we can include ACME in the promo. Otherwise they go into the post-launch blog only.
eve: Ops note — make sure asset delivery to CDN happens with asset tags: `acme-case-2026`, and schedule publish window at 10am PT on launch day. I'll handle once marketing posts the final assets.
tim: For the benchmark narrative, let's not call out specific model sizes publicly without ACME OK. We can phrase it like: "using Redwood's optimized runtime, ACME reduced latency and cost" and include a callout with the internal benchmark ID `bench-acme-0426`.
anya: Draft quote options posted in the doc — short and long variants. Anyone object to me sending both to ACME and asking them to pick? less back-and-forth.
sam: good plan. I'll loop in the ACME product sponsor and ask them to pick one. I told them we need permission for the ARR number and marketing use.
devon: Please ask ACME to approve the final quote and sign the release PDF (I attached it to the doc). If they send edits, reply with tracked-changes and I'll approve or request legal redlines.
maria: If ACME asks for an embargo, prefer 48h embargo. note for PR: include embargo in the release and in the webinar invite.
anya: Will add embargo options in the outreach message. Draft outreach: "Thanks — we loved working with you, would you be willing to provide a short quote for a customer spotlight? We can send short options for you to pick." Keep it casual.
josh: Uploading the metric screenshots to the doc now. Also adding a short runbook for CS quotes: who to cc and what to ask.
sam: ACME says ok to % uplift and prefers not to show raw ARR. They want to sign the release but may request one phrasing tweak.
devon: fine — send me their tweak and I'll quick-turn it. If it's cosmetic, we can approve within hours.
publish-bot: Reminder: interview set for Wed 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to maria, anya, acme-contact, josh (CS). If changes, update event link.
maria: Thanks all. Action items: anya — finalize interview script + quotes; josh — upload verified metrics; sam — get customer approval for % uplift + release; devon — stand by for sign-off; eve — prep CDN tags. If we have approvals by Tue 5pm PT we go for Apr 14 webinar inclusion. :rocket:
anya: Got it. I'll post the final script by Mon noon and ping this thread.
